one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) for businesses to send/receive WhatsApp messages programmatically.

auth.evidence_quote: When making API requests, include your token in an authorization request header, preceded by Bearer.
auth.notes: System User access tokens (permanent, tied to a System User rather than a personal login) are the standard integration credential; OAuth-style app dashboard flow is used to generate them.

access.notes: Search results (not independently fetched/quoted) indicate a Meta Business app and WhatsApp Business Account setup are required, with permissions like whatsapp_business_messaging; production messaging to arbitrary numbers beyond test numbers typically requires Meta App Review. Could not find a fetched page stating the review requirement explicitly, so evidence_url is null per the no-invented-URL rule.

api.notes: No official Meta-published MCP server found; lharries/whatsapp-mcp is a widely-forked community project (note: it wraps personal WhatsApp via whatsmeow, not the official Business Cloud API).

verdict.rationale: Requires a Meta Business app, WhatsApp Business Account setup, and (for production-scale messaging to arbitrary users) Meta App Review before full third-party use.
